####################################################################################################################################################################
The above steps in the section of KSI were done to create a new dataset called ksi_mont_cl.geojson (will be read as "ksi_mont" below), which is the KSI collisions in Montreal from 2017 to 2022, with the nearest center line road segment's attributes joined to it. Now we can read this file and continue with the analysis. Thus, to save time in running the codes, I commented our the above codes and just read the file ksi_mont.
####################################################################################################################################################################

```{r}
ksi_mont <- st_read('/Users/omidrezasadrmanesh/Desktop/TMU/PROJECTS/VOLUME/Montreal/Datasets/collisions/Outputs/ksi_mont_cl.geojson')
# View(ksi_mont)
# colnames(ksi_mont)
# nrow(ksi_mont)

# Using floor_date, change the format of date to be the first day of the month, and create a new column called collision_month
ksi_mont <- ksi_mont %>%
  mutate(collision_month = floor_date(date, "month"))

# filter it for relevant columns
# colnames(ksi_mont)
ksi_mont <- ksi_mont %>% 
  select(KSI_ID,Road_UID, collision_month, geometry)
```

Create study_start and study_end based on the range of collision_month in ksi_tor (you will need this for expected coverage)

```{r}
study_start <- min(ksi_mont$collision_month)
study_end   <- max(ksi_mont$collision_month)
# study_start
# study_end
```

Calculate m_j = number of KSIs in segment-month j, then sum(m_j^2) across all segment-months for the variance calculation

```{r}
ksi_mont_seg_month <- ksi_mont %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Road_UID, collision_month) %>%
  summarise(m_j = n(), .groups = "drop")
# View(ksi_mont_seg_month)

# Calculate 
sum_mj_sq <- sum(ksi_mont_seg_month$m_j^2)
cat("Sum of m_j^2 across all segment-months:", sum_mj_sq, "\n")
```

Create time windows for KSI 

Create monthly windows so for 1,2,and 3 months will cover 3, 5, and 7 months respectively (because we want to cover 1 month before and after the collision month, so in total 3 months for 1M window because the month of collision will also be considered)

```{r}
ksi_mont <- ksi_mont %>%
  mutate(
    window_3M_start = collision_month %m-% months(1),
    window_3M_end   = collision_month %m+% months(1),

    window_5M_start = collision_month %m-% months(2),
    window_5M_end   = collision_month %m+% months(2),

    window_7M_start = collision_month %m-% months(3),
    window_7M_end   = collision_month %m+% months(3)
  )
# View(ksi_mont)
```

*The above chunks of codes were done to create a new dataset called "temp_mont_final.geojson" (will be read as "temp_mont" below), which is the temporary counters in Montreal from 2016/10 to 2023/03, with the nearest center line road segment's attributes joined to it. Now we can read this file and continue with the analysis. Thus, to save time in running the codes, I commented out the above codes and just read the file temp_mont*

############################################################################################################################################

```{r}
temp_mont <- st_read('/Users/omidrezasadrmanesh/Desktop/TMU/PROJECTS/VOLUME/Montreal/Datasets/counters/temporary/Outputs/temp_cl_mont.geojson')
# View(temp_mont)

# Create "month" from "count_date" as we want to have a column in the format of date, and we don't care about the exact count date, and only want a column in the format of date
temp_mont <- temp_mont %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    count_date = as.Date(Date),
    month = floor_date(Date, "month"))

# Keep relevant columns
temp_mont <- temp_mont %>%
  select(Road_UID, location_name, month)
# View(temp_mont)
```

Create a new dataset including unique temporary counters, with a unique ID for each of them, and a column specifying the type of them

```{r}
temp_mont_monthly <- temp_mont %>% 
  distinct()
# View(temp_mont_monthly)
# colnames(temp_mont_monthly)

# unique temporary counters
temp_mont_unique <- temp_mont_monthly %>%
  distinct(location_name, .keep_all = TRUE)
# View(temp_mont_unique)

# Drop Road_UID as we don't need it for the coverage analysis
temp_mont_unique <- temp_mont_unique %>% 
  select(-Road_UID)
# View(temp_mont_unique)

# create a new ID for each unique counter location
temp_mont_unique <- temp_mont_unique %>%
  mutate(counter_id = row_number())
# View(temp_mont_unique)

# Reorder columns to have counter_id first and mutate counter_type to be "temporary"
temp_mont_unique <- temp_mont_unique %>%
  mutate(counter_type = "temporary") %>%
  group_by(location_name) %>%
  mutate(
    first_count_month = min(month),
    last_count_month  = max(month)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(counter_id, everything())
# View(temp_mont_unique)  
```

## Create c_P_t and c_R_t (from these codes: COVERAGE_JUL26.Rmd)

Create a dataframe of all months in the study period, which will be used to ensure that we have a row for each month in the final monthly deployment dataset, even if there are no new permanent counters or active counters in that month.

```{r}
months_df <- tibble(
  month = seq(
    floor_date(study_start, "month"),
    floor_date(study_end, "month"),
    by = "1 month"
  )
)
# View(months_df)
```

### Step A. Clean counter data
Create start_month and end_month for each counter, and filter out any counters that don't have a valid counter_id, counter_type, start_month, or end_month, or that are not active during the study period.

```{r}
# View(temp_mont_unique)
counter_clean <- temp_mont_unique %>%
  mutate(
    start_month = floor_date(as.Date(first_count_month), "month"),
    end_month = if_else(
      is.na(last_count_month),
      floor_date(study_end, "month"),
      floor_date(as.Date(last_count_month), "month")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(counter_id),
    !is.na(counter_type),
    !is.na(start_month),
    start_month <= floor_date(study_end, "month"),
    end_month >= floor_date(study_start, "month")
  )
# View(counter_clean)
```

### Step B. Expand counters into active counter-months
Here we expand the counter data into a long format where each row represents a counter active in a specific month. This will allow us to count the number of active temporary counters in each month.

```{r}
# View(counter_clean)

counter_months <- counter_clean %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    month = list(seq(start_month, end_month, by = "1 month"))
  ) %>%
  unnest(month) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    month >= floor_date(study_start, "month"),
    month <= floor_date(study_end, "month")
  )
# View(counter_months)
```

### Step C. Count active temporary counters each month
      c_R_t = active temporary/rotating counters in month t

```{r}
monthly_active_counters <- counter_months %>%
  group_by(month, counter_type) %>%
  summarise(
    c_t = n_distinct(counter_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    month = months_df$month,
    counter_type = c("temporary"),
    fill = list(c_t = 0)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = counter_type,
    values_from = c_t,
    names_prefix = "c_",
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  rename(
    c_R_t = c_temporary
  )
# View(monthly_active_counters)
```

### Step D. Final monthly deployment dataset

```{r}
monthly_counter_deployment <- months_df %>%
  left_join(monthly_active_counters, by = "month") %>%
  mutate(
    c_R_t = replace_na(c_R_t, 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(month)
# View(monthly_counter_deployment)
```

## Observed Coverage 

Calculate the coverage by temporary counters for each KSI collision by checking if there is any counter on the same road segment in the same month or within the defined windows (±1M, ±2M, ±3M) (1= covered, 0 = not covered)

```{r}
# View(temp_mont_monthly)
# colnames(temp_mont_monthly)
# View(ksi_mont)

ksi_mont_cov_temp <- ksi_mont %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    temp_3M = as.integer(any(
      temp_mont_monthly$Road_UID == Road_UID &
      temp_mont_monthly$month >= window_3M_start &
      temp_mont_monthly$month <= window_3M_end
    )),

    temp_5M = as.integer(any(
      temp_mont_monthly$Road_UID == Road_UID &
      temp_mont_monthly$month >= window_5M_start &
      temp_mont_monthly$month <= window_5M_end
    )),

    temp_7M = as.integer(any(
      temp_mont_monthly$Road_UID == Road_UID &
      temp_mont_monthly$month >= window_7M_start &
      temp_mont_monthly$month <= window_7M_end
    ))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# View(ksi_mont_cov_temp)

# Export this for analysis of Road Types
write_csv(ksi_mont_cov_temp, "/Users/omidrezasadrmanesh/Desktop/TMU/PROJECTS/VOLUME/Montreal/Datasets/collisions/Outputs/ksi_mont_cov_RoadClass.csv")
```

Calculate observed coverage by temporary counters for each window (±1M, ±2M, ±3M) (95% CI)

```{r}
total_ksi <- nrow(ksi_mont)
# total_ksi

temp_obs_3M_coverage <- sum(ksi_mont_cov_temp$temp_3M, na.rm = TRUE)
temp_obs_3M_pct <- round(100 * temp_obs_3M_coverage / total_ksi, 2)
temp_obs_3M_CI <- binom.test(temp_obs_3M_coverage, total_ksi)$conf.int * 100

temp_obs_5M_coverage <- sum(ksi_mont_cov_temp$temp_5M, na.rm = TRUE)
temp_obs_5M_pct <- round(100 * temp_obs_5M_coverage / total_ksi, 2)
temp_obs_5M_CI <- binom.test(temp_obs_5M_coverage, total_ksi)$conf.int * 100

temp_obs_7M_coverage <- sum(ksi_mont_cov_temp$temp_7M, na.rm = TRUE)
temp_obs_7M_pct <- round(100 * temp_obs_7M_coverage / total_ksi, 2)
temp_obs_7M_CI <- binom.test(temp_obs_7M_coverage, total_ksi)$conf.int * 100
```

Make a table for average overall observed coverage by temporary counters

```{r}
temp_obs_results_average <- tibble(
  Window = c("±1 month (w=3)", "±2 months (w=5)", "±3 months (w=7)"),
  
  Observed_pct = c(temp_obs_3M_pct, temp_obs_5M_pct, temp_obs_7M_pct),
  CI_lower_pct_obs = c(temp_obs_3M_CI[1], temp_obs_5M_CI[1], temp_obs_7M_CI[1]),
  CI_upper_pct_obs = c(temp_obs_3M_CI[2], temp_obs_5M_CI[2], temp_obs_7M_CI[2])
)
# View(temp_obs_results_average)
```

*Yearly* observed coverage by temporary counters

```{r}
# View(ksi_mont_cov_temp)

temp_obs_results_yearly <- ksi_mont_cov_temp %>%
  group_by(year = year(collision_month)) %>%
   summarise(
       total_ksi = n(),
       
       temp_obs_3M_coverage = sum(temp_3M, na.rm = TRUE),
       temp_obs_3M_pct = round(100 * temp_obs_3M_coverage / total_ksi, 2),
       temp_obs_3M_CI_lower = binom.test(temp_obs_3M_coverage, total_ksi)$conf.int[1] * 100,
       temp_obs_3M_CI_upper = binom.test(temp_obs_3M_coverage, total_ksi)$conf.int[2] * 100,
       
       temp_obs_5M_coverage = sum(temp_5M, na.rm = TRUE),
       temp_obs_5M_pct = round(100 * temp_obs_5M_coverage / total_ksi, 2),
       temp_obs_5M_CI_lower = binom.test(temp_obs_5M_coverage, total_ksi)$conf.int[1] * 100,
       temp_obs_5M_CI_upper = binom.test(temp_obs_5M_coverage, total_ksi)$conf.int[2] * 100,
       
       temp_obs_7M_coverage = sum(temp_7M, na.rm = TRUE),
       temp_obs_7M_pct = round(100 * temp_obs_7M_coverage / total_ksi, 2),
       temp_obs_7M_CI_lower = binom.test(temp_obs_7M_coverage, total_ksi)$conf.int[1] * 100,
       temp_obs_7M_CI_upper = binom.test(temp_obs_7M_coverage, total_ksi)$conf.int[2] * 100) %>% 
  
  select(year, total_ksi,
          temp_obs_3M_pct, temp_obs_3M_CI_lower, temp_obs_3M_CI_upper,
          temp_obs_5M_pct, temp_obs_5M_CI_lower, temp_obs_5M_CI_upper,
          temp_obs_7M_pct, temp_obs_7M_CI_lower, temp_obs_7M_CI_upper) 
# View(temp_obs_results_yearly)
```

## Expected Coverage

KSI_total = total number of KSI
For each month t∈{1,…,T}:

  g_t : average number of segments covered by a single counter. To calculate g_t: u_t/c_t, where u_t is the unique road segments covered by the counters.

### STEP 2. Logit-transformed CI for a proportion p_hat with SE on the proportion scale

```{r}
logit_ci <- function(p_hat, se_p, conf_level = 0.95) {
  z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - conf_level) / 2)
  
  # avoid issues exactly at 0 or 1
  eps <- 1e-8
  p_hat_adj <- min(max(p_hat, eps), 1 - eps)
  
  logit_p  <- qlogis(p_hat_adj)
  se_logit <- se_p / (p_hat_adj * (1 - p_hat_adj))
  
  lower <- plogis(logit_p - z * se_logit)
  upper <- plogis(logit_p + z * se_logit)
  
  c(lower = lower, upper = upper)
}
```

### STEP 4. MONTHLY COVERAGE PROBABILITIES

Permanent counters remain active after installation:
$qP_t = 1 - prod_{m<=t} (1 - gP_m/S)^(new_perm_m)$

Temporary counters: 
$qR_t = 1 - (1 - gR_t/S)^(cR_t)$

```{r}

  mutate(
    qR_t = 1 - (1 - gR_t / S) ^ c_R_t
  )
# View(monthly_cov)
```

### STEP 6. COMPUTE WINDOW-SPECIFIC PROBABILITIES BY COUNTER TYPE

Uses real monthly counter deployment from monthly_cov and real KSI segment-month clusters from cluster_tbl.
p_temp_t:probability of temporary-counter coverage at least once within the window.

```{r}
compute_pwt <- function(monthly_cov, w = 3) {
  
  stopifnot(w %in% c(3, 5, 7))
  
  Tm <- nrow(monthly_cov)
  half_w <- (w - 1) / 2
  
  p_temp_t <- numeric(Tm)
  
  for (i in 1:Tm) {
    
    idx <- max(1, i - half_w):min(Tm, i + half_w)
    
    
    # Temporary counters:
    # Rotating/temporary counters create new opportunities across months.
    p_temp_t[i] <- 1 - prod(1 - monthly_cov$qR_t[idx], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  monthly_cov %>%
    mutate(
      w = w,
      p_temp_t = p_temp_t
    )
}
```

### STEP 7. SUMMARISE COVERAGE FOR ONE PROBABILITY COLUMN

Uses real segment-month clusters:
$E[C]   = sum_j m_j * p_t$
$Var(C) = sum_j p_t * (1 - p_t) * m_j^2$

where:
   m_j = number of KSI events in segment-month cluster j
   p_t = expected coverage probability for that month/window/type

```{r}
summarise_one_type <- function(cluster_tbl2, prob_col, type_label, conf_level = 0.95) {
  
  annual_res <- cluster_tbl2 %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      E_C   = sum(m_j * .data[[prob_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Var_C = sum(.data[[prob_col]] * (1 - .data[[prob_col]]) * (m_j^2), na.rm = TRUE),
      K     = sum(m_j, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      p_hat = E_C / K,
      se_p  = sqrt(Var_C) / K,
      coverage_pct = 100 * p_hat,
      ci_obj = list(logit_ci(p_hat, se_p, conf_level)),
      ci_lower = 100 * ci_obj["lower"],
      ci_upper = 100 * ci_obj["upper"],
      type = type_label
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
      type,
      year,
      K,
      E_C,
      Var_C,
      coverage_pct,
      ci_lower,
      ci_upper
    )
  
  # Overall pooled estimate
  total_E_C   <- sum(annual_res$E_C, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_Var_C <- sum(annual_res$Var_C, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_K     <- sum(annual_res$K, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  overall_p_hat <- total_E_C / total_K
  overall_se_p  <- sqrt(total_Var_C) / total_K
  overall_ci    <- logit_ci(overall_p_hat, overall_se_p, conf_level)
  
  overall_res <- tibble(
    type = type_label,
    total_K = total_K,
    total_E_C = total_E_C,
    total_Var_C = total_Var_C,
    pooled_coverage_pct = 100 * overall_p_hat,
    ci_lower = 100 * overall_ci["lower"],
    ci_upper = 100 * overall_ci["upper"]
  )
  
  list(
    annual = annual_res,
    overall = overall_res
  )
}

pwt_tbl <- compute_pwt(monthly_cov, w = 3) %>%
  select(month, year, p_temp_t)

cluster_tbl2 <- cluster_tbl %>%

res_temp <- summarise_one_type(cluster_tbl2, "p_temp_t", "temporary")
```

### STEP 8. COMPUTE FULL SUMMARY FOR ONE WINDOW

```{r}
compute_coverage_summary <- function(monthly_cov, cluster_tbl, w = 3, conf_level = 0.95) {
  
  # Month-specific probabilities by counter type
  pwt_tbl <- compute_pwt(monthly_cov, w) %>%
    select(month, year, p_temp_t)
  
  # Attach month-specific probabilities to each real segment-month cluster
  cluster_tbl2 <- cluster_tbl %>%
    left_join(pwt_tbl, by = c("month", "year"))
  
  # Check for unmatched KSI months
  unmatched_months <- cluster_tbl2 %>%
    filter(is.na(p_temp_t)) %>%
    distinct(month, year)
  
  if (nrow(unmatched_months) > 0) {
    warning(
      "Some KSI segment-month clusters did not match monthly_cov. ",
      "Check that month formats and study periods are aligned."
    )
    print(unmatched_months)
  }
  
  # Summarise 
  res_temp <- summarise_one_type(cluster_tbl2, "p_temp_t", "temporary", conf_level)
  
  annual_all_types <- bind_rows(
    res_temp$annual
  ) %>%
    arrange(type, year)
  
  overall_all_types <- bind_rows(
    res_temp$overall
  ) %>%
    mutate(w = w) %>%
    select(w, everything())
  
  list(
    monthly_pwt = pwt_tbl,
    cluster_table = cluster_tbl2,
    annual_by_type = annual_all_types,
    overall_by_type = overall_all_types,
    unmatched_months = unmatched_months
  )
}
```

```{r}
temp_mont_monthly_roadclass <- temp_mont %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(
    month = floor_date(as.Date(month), "month")
  ) %>%
  select(Road_UID, month) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
# ── Montreal: temporary counters only ────────────────────────────────────────

## 1. Extract Full Dynamic Study Range
all_months_mont <- temp_mont_monthly_roadclass$month
min_study_date_mont <- min(all_months_mont, na.rm = TRUE)
max_study_date_mont <- max(all_months_mont, na.rm = TRUE)
total_study_months_mont <- length(seq.Date(min_study_date_mont, 
                                            max_study_date_mont, 
                                            by = "month"))

## 2. No deduplication needed — only one counter type
# Join centreline to assign road class
combined_active_cl_mont <- temp_mont_monthly_roadclass %>%
  dplyr::select(Road_UID, month) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(
    cl_mont_RoadClass %>% dplyr::select(Road_UID, road_class),
    by = "Road_UID"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(road_class))

## 3. Calculate Capacity per Road Class
cl_class_capacity_mont <- cl_mont_RoadClass %>%
  filter(!is.na(road_class)) %>%
  group_by(road_class) %>%
  summarise(
    total_segments = n_distinct(Road_UID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_possible_road_months = total_segments * total_study_months_mont
  )

## 4. Compute Coverage Columns
counter_events_by_class_mont <- combined_active_cl_mont %>%
  group_by(road_class) %>%
  summarise(
    total_monitored_road_months = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  right_join(cl_class_capacity_mont, by = "road_class") %>%
  replace_na(list(total_monitored_road_months = 0)) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_combined_network_coverage = round(
      100 * total_monitored_road_months / total_possible_road_months, 2
    ),
    pct_counter_activity = round(
      100 * total_monitored_road_months / sum(total_monitored_road_months), 2
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_combined_network_coverage))

print(counter_events_by_class_mont)

write.csv(counter_events_by_class_mont,
          '/Users/omidrezasadrmanesh/Desktop/TMU/PROJECTS/VOLUME/Montreal/Datasets/road class/outputs/counter_events_by_class_mont.csv')
```

### Expected Coverage

```{r}
# colnames(temp_mont_monthly)

covered_per_month_temp_class <- temp_mont_monthly %>%
  left_join(cl_mont_RoadClass %>% dplyr::select(Road_UID, road_class),
            by = "Road_UID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(road_class)) %>%
  group_by(road_class, month) %>%
  summarise(
    c_t = n_distinct(location_name),
    u_t = n_distinct(Road_UID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(g_t = if_else(c_t == 0, 0, u_t / c_t))

# Mean g_t per road class (months with active counters only)
g_t_temp_class <- covered_per_month_temp_class %>%
  filter(c_t > 0) %>%
  group_by(road_class) %>%
  summarise(g_t_temp = mean(g_t, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# View both
g_t_temp_class
```

```{r}
cluster_tbl_class <- cluster_tbl %>%
  left_join(cl_mont_RoadClass,
            by = c("segment_id" = "Road_UID")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(road_class))

# Then for each road class separately
road_classes <- unique(cluster_tbl_class$road_class)

exp_by_class_list <- lapply(road_classes, function(rc) {
  
  cluster_rc <- cluster_tbl_class %>% filter(road_class == rc)
  
  # Road-class-specific S
  S_class <- cl_mont_RoadClass %>%
    filter(road_class == rc) %>%
    pull(Road_UID) %>% 
    n_distinct()  # number of segments in this class
  
  # Road-class-specific g_t
  g_t_temp_rc <- g_t_temp_class %>%
    filter(road_class == rc) %>%
    pull(g_t_temp)
  
  # Handle road classes with no counters
  if (length(g_t_temp_rc) == 0) g_t_temp_rc <- 0

  # Road-class-specific c_P_t and c_R_t per month
  c_R_class <- covered_per_month_temp_class %>%
    filter(road_class == rc) %>%
    dplyr::select(month, c_R_class_t = c_t)

  # Join to monthly_input
  monthly_input_class <- monthly_input %>%
    left_join(c_R_class, by = "month") %>%
    mutate(
      c_R_class_t = replace_na(c_R_class_t, 0),
      gR_t = g_t_temp_rc
    )
  
  monthly_cov_class <- monthly_input_class %>%
    mutate(qR_t = 1 - (1 - gR_t / S_class) ^ c_R_class_t)
  
  res3 <- compute_coverage_summary(monthly_cov_class, cluster_rc, w = 3)
  res5 <- compute_coverage_summary(monthly_cov_class, cluster_rc, w = 5)
  res7 <- compute_coverage_summary(monthly_cov_class, cluster_rc, w = 7)
  
  bind_rows(
    res3$overall_by_type,
    res5$overall_by_type,
    res7$overall_by_type
  ) %>%
    mutate(road_class = rc)
})

# ── Bind all road class results ───────────────────────────────────────────────
exp_by_class <- bind_rows(exp_by_class_list)

# ── Filter to combined counter type and format ────────────────────────────────
exp_by_class_clean <- exp_by_class %>%
  mutate(
    Window = case_when(
      w == 3 ~ "±1 month (w=3)",
      w == 5 ~ "±2 months (w=5)",
      w == 7 ~ "±3 months (w=7)"
    ),
    exp_pct   = round(pooled_coverage_pct, 2),
    exp_CI_lo = round(ci_lower, 2),
    exp_CI_hi = round(ci_upper, 2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(road_class, Window, exp_pct, exp_CI_lo, exp_CI_hi)

View(exp_by_class_clean)

# Export this
write.csv(exp_by_class_clean, '/Users/omidrezasadrmanesh/Desktop/TMU/PROJECTS/VOLUME/Montreal/Datasets/road class/Outputs/exp_by_class.csv')
```
